title: Apple Refrigerator Pickles
description: This recipe pickles fresh apple slices in the refrigerator for one week in a mix of water, cider vinegar, sugar, allspice, cloves, nutmeg, and ginger.

steps.text: Inspect 2 quart-sized jars for cracks and rings for rust, discarding any defective ones. Immerse in simmering water until apple pickles ready. Wash new, unused lids and rings in warm soapy water.
Combine water, vinegar, sugar, allspice berries, cloves, nutmeg, and ginger in a small saucepan; bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Meanwhile, toss apples with lemon juice in a bowl; pack into hot, sterilized jars.

Pour boiling sugar syrup over apples, filling to within ¼ inch of tops. Wipe rims with a moist paper towel to remove any residue. Top with lids and screw rings on tightly. Set jars aside at room temperature until cool, about 2 hours.
Press centers of lids with a finger to ensure lids do not move up or down. Place jars in the refrigerator; wait before opening for at least 1 week.
